ns2:course.label: Freshman Business Honors Seminar
ns2:course.description: Introduction to business and an overview of the role of the Gies College of Business and the University of Illinois in providing opportunities for undergraduates to prepare to become business leaders. Introduction to the Gies College of Business Honors Program, a leadership program for approximately 40 incoming freshmen in the Gies College of Business. Students will begin to work as a team to use leadership in service to all undergraduates in the Gies College of Business. Credit is not given for BUS 120 and BUS 115. Prerequisite: First-year student in the Gies Business Honors program.
